name: quickframe-t2-script
description: QuickFrame T2 script engine — turns a topic + cfg into the §3 job JSON. Replaces the deterministic engine.js stub with a real LLM-backed script call. Node built-ins only, no deps, no keys required for the offline/agent path.

scripts.sample: node bin/cli.js --provider agent --response out/sample-response.json --topic "why airplane mode still drains your battery overnight" --spine inside --seconds 30 --out samples/inside-airplane-mode-battery.job.json
